F0: Future definitions only. Record exact build, OS, edition, locale, actual visible state, source provenance, package/profile/recovery identities and separate authorization before any later action. This packet performs no original/native/app/hardware/account/install/update/reset/recovery/destructive action.
F-INSTALL: Independently known valid owned package and entitlement, supported identified platform, backed-up disposable install/profile and pre-action inventory; account/installer fixtures NOT provided.
F-INSTALL-MAC: F-INSTALL with independently identified macOS version and eligible .dmg baseline; no mounted image provided.
F-INSTALL-WIN: F-INSTALL with independently identified Windows/version/edition and valid ZIP/extracted package baseline; no installer provided.
F-AUTH: Independently valid owned installation, entitlement and permitted account state; no credentials, codes or authorization files provided.
F-AUTH-ONLINE: F-AUTH plus separately known internet/browser handoff and successful authorization baseline; no login/service interaction performed.
F-AUTH-OFFLINE: F-AUTH plus independently valid owned code/file and known successful offline baseline; no code/.auz bytes provided.
F-UPDATE: Independently known current and eligible available release, owned valid packages, backed-up disposable profile, recorded policy/consent and successful baseline; no update performed.
F-RESET: Independently valid copied profile, known custom settings/template/undo items and complete independent backups; no file moved.
F-RESET-MAC: F-RESET on identified macOS/version-specific profile copy.
F-RESET-WIN: F-RESET on identified Windows/version-specific profile copy.
F-CRASH: Independently retained reproducible owned issue traces and matched ordinary-launch baseline; no crash induced or process terminated.
F-RECOVER: Independently retained owned matching incident items, same-version source identities, complete backups and known valid recovery baseline; fixture copies NOT provided.
F-RECOVER-AUDIO: F-RECOVER plus independently known nonempty owned recording, valid capture identity and calibrated nonzero playback baseline.
F-PROJECT: Independently valid nonempty owned Set/media/automation, known save/open and positive record/playback baselines; no Set/recording provided.
positive-path-gate: Negative, cancellation, no-effect and loss cases require separately established valid owned package/entitlement/config/recovery baseline. Signal cases additionally need nonempty eligible source/valid format, enabled active path/control, nonzero amount/gain/send, nonmuted return/output and independently calibrated positive source/return/output baseline. Recording requires admitted Monitor/arm/clip/record/transport gates. Absent entitlement, muted output, missing port, no eligible release or failed positive baseline is inconclusive; no real disk exhaustion or account mutation.
